BFA.note: Mass enrolment launch; no other system checking people against the ID stated.

facts.fact: leFaso.net reports that Burkina Faso launched on 11 November 2026 mass enrolment of residents into its Registre de l'identifiant unique, after a pilot that enrolled over 16,000 people, with ten-finger and iris capture, deduplication, and a first count due at the end of December 2026.
